2610.12393.title: HRIL: Learning Multimodal Synergy via Higher-Order Tensor Modeling
2610.12393.paper_summary: Self-supervised multimodal representation learning has achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet capturing synergistic information remains challenging due to the complexity of cross-modal interactions. Unlike the shared information across individual modalities, synergy arises when task-relevant signals emerge only from the joint configuration of multiple modalities and cannot be recovered from any modality in isolation. This work focuses on how to preserve the information capacity for such synergistic signals in multimodal representations. The key observation is that synergistic information is reflected in higher-order statistical dependence among modalities, which provides a principled target for explicitly modeling joint interactions. Motivated by this insight, we propose Higher-order Representation and Information Learning (HRIL), which constructs an empirical cross-moment tensor over modality embeddings to represent multi-way interactions. HRIL employs Tucker decomposition to obtain a core tensor, complemented by a synergy-aware regularizer that prevents energy concentration and preserves higher-order coupling capacity for synergistic information capture. Experiments on the controlled synergy task and real-world benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing multimodal contrastive methods, with notable gains on tasks dominated by synergistic interactions. Code is released at https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL.
2610.12393.paper_summary_zh: 自我監督的多模態表示學習在各個領域取得了顯著的成功，但由於跨模態互動的複雜性，捕捉協同信息仍然具有挑戰性。與各個模態之間共享的信息不同，協同效應出現在與任務相關的信號僅從多個模態的聯合配置中產生，而無法從任何單一模態中獨立恢復。這項工作專注於如何在多模態表示中保留這種協同信號的信息容量。關鍵觀察是，協同信息體現在模態之間的高階統計依賴性中，這為明確建模聯合互動提供了一個原則性的目標。受到這一見解的啟發，我們提出了高階表示與信息學習（HRIL），該方法構建了一個基於模態嵌入的實證交叉矩量張量，以表示多向互動。HRIL採用塔克分解來獲取核心張量，並輔以一個考慮協同效應的正則化器，以防止能量集中並保留高階耦合能力，以捕捉協同信息。在受控協同任務和現實世界基準上的實驗顯示，與現有的多模態對比方法相比，HRIL在協同互動主導的任務上取得了顯著的改進。代碼已在 https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL 上發布。
